notes.source: Published pipeline summary products (outputs/coverage/*.parquet); no row-level events/links were read.
notes.stage_counts: Counts are the principal published table for each stage, summed over the 79 census councils.
notes.units: Building events and matched planning applications are different record types, so they are not a ratio of one another.
notes.match_rate: Match rate is the share of the linked-side planning applications resolved to building work, across the councils with matching set up only.
notes.excluded_stream: glenelg_building (an internal building stream, not a census council) is excluded to avoid double counting.

stages.label: Planning applications collected
stages.note: Applications in each council's planning register.

stages.label: Properties resolved
stages.note: Planning records resolved to an address and property, with land area.

stages.label: Building events collected
stages.note: Building permits and events from council and VBA records.

stages.label: Planning applications matched
stages.note: Applications matched to a building event.
